description: Executor-neutral black-box conformance fixtures for the Hubu spend-executor contract. Every request targets the public Hubu HTTP API. Executors claim by the spend_auth_token_id and settle or release by the claim_id Hubu issued; the retired v4.3 agent_id/operation_key identity appears only in steps marked legacy_identity_probe, which must be rejected. Server-generated IDs and timestamps are captured and asserted by relation, never by literal value. Executor responses never carry the private operation key.

server_profile.lease_config_yaml:
authorization_ttl_seconds: 300
default_lease_profile: default
lease_profiles:
  default:
    claim_ttl_seconds: 900
  conformance_short:
    claim_ttl_seconds: 1

credentials.normal_bearer: HUBU_AUTH_TOKEN; shared by agent-side, observer and executor-side requests
credentials.human_reconciliation_capability: HUBU_RECONCILIATION_TOKEN; sent only by human reconciliation steps in the X-Hubu-Reconciliation-Capability header

setup.policy_yaml:
id: executor_conformance
version: v1
default_effect: deny
rules:
  - id: allow_local_fixture_provider
    effect: allow
    reason: executor conformance fixture provider
    when:
      op: eq
      field: provider
      value:
        string: provider:local:fixture
setup.per_scenario: The runner registers one fresh agent and one agent budget per scenario and exposes them as ${agent.agent_id}, ${agent.account_id} and ${budget.budget_id}.

replay_exactly.trigger: No HTTP response was observed (dropped response, timeout, connection loss, process restart) or Hubu returned 5xx.
replay_exactly.executor_action: Retry the identical request. Authorization retries reuse the same operation_key (platform side); claim retries reuse the same spend_auth_token_id; settle and release retries use the same claim_id, and a lost claim_id is recovered by replaying the identical claim. Hubu returns the stored authorization, claim, settlement or release without a second hold, consumption or ledger posting.

create_new_operation.trigger: An authorization retry changed immutable scope after an allowed, pending or side-effect-capable attempt.
create_new_operation.executor_action: Do not reuse the operation key for different work; the platform starts a new logical operation.

reuse_operation_key_after_denial.trigger: Policy or budget denied the attempt without creating a token or hold.
reuse_operation_key_after_denial.executor_action: No executor work may start. The platform may reuse the key with corrected scope, which appends a new revision.

stop_claim_mismatch.trigger: A claim presented an amount, account or scope that differs from the stored authorization.

observed.error_contains: payment request does not match authorized spend

stop_claim_mismatch.executor_action: Stop. Never perform provider work; the hold stays with the unclaimed authorization.

await_human_reconciliation_expired.trigger: Normal settle or release reached a claim whose lease expired.

observed.error_contains: executor claim expired and requires reconciliation

await_human_reconciliation_expired.executor_action: Keep the claim, provider evidence and exact cost. Do not release or repeat provider work; a human resolves the claim.

await_human_reconciliation_overrun.trigger: Normal settlement reported a conservative budget charge above the authorized maximum.

observed.error_contains: actual vendor cost exceeds the authorized maximum

await_human_reconciliation_overrun.executor_action: Keep the claimed hold and exact evidence and route to human reconciliation after lease expiry. Never release billed work.

stop_receipt_conflict.trigger: A settlement retry changed any exact-cost, provider, snapshot or artifact field.

observed.error_contains: settlement receipt does not match the original settlement

stop_receipt_conflict.executor_action: Stop. Replay only the original immutable receipt.

terminal_already_settled.trigger: Release was attempted after settlement committed.

observed.error_contains: executor claim has already been settled

terminal_already_settled.executor_action: Inspect the claim and treat the operation as settled; replay the identical settlement to recover the stored result.

terminal_already_released.trigger: Settlement was attempted after release committed.

observed.error_contains: executor claim has already been released

terminal_already_released.executor_action: Inspect the claim and treat the operation as released.

human_capability_missing.trigger: A reconciliation-shaped request carried only the normal bearer.
human_capability_missing.executor_action: Executors never reconcile; surface the claim to a human.

human_capability_invalid.trigger: A reconciliation-shaped request presented the normal bearer as the human capability.
human_capability_invalid.executor_action: Executors never reconcile; surface the claim to a human.

stop_reconciliation_conflict.trigger: A reconciliation retry changed its evidence after the outcome was stored.
stop_reconciliation_conflict.executor_action: Stop. The first recorded human outcome is terminal.

reject_retired_v4_3_identity.trigger: An executor request carried the retired v4.3 agent_id/operation_key identity.
reject_retired_v4_3_identity.executor_action: Stop. Claim by spend_auth_token_id and settle or release by claim_id.

reject_token_finalization.trigger: Settle or release named the operation by spend_auth_token_id instead of claim_id.

observed.error_contains: replay the identical claim with the same spend_auth_token_id

reject_token_finalization.executor_action: Settle or release by claim_id. To recover a lost claim_id, replay the identical claim.

scenarios.title: authorize and claim two independent provider operations under one agent budget
settle both operations with precise actual costs and immutable provider/artifact references
retry authorization, claim, and finalization after ambiguous responses without duplicate holds or consumption
reject operation-key reuse with changed spend scope
release cleanly when failure occurs before billable provider work, including after a lost claim response
preserve billed work after settlement response loss and return the stored terminal result
expire a claimed lease into the reconciliation queue without automatically releasing its hold
reconcile vendor-billed and vendor-did-not-bill outcomes with the separate human capability
